mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_chunk(id, doc_id, kb_id, workspace_id, text, ordinal, embedding_vec, doc_version, chunk_type, parent_chunk_id, page_start, page_end, block_ids_json, context_prefix, create_at, update_at, create_by, update_by, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{docId}, #{kbId}, #{workspaceId}, #{text}, #{ordinal}, CAST(#{vectorLiteral} AS vector), #{docVersion}, #{chunkType}, #{parentChunkId}, #{pageStart}, #{pageEnd}, #{blockIdsJson}, #{contextPrefix}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system', 'system', FALSE)
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_chunk SET embedding_vec = CAST(#{vectorLiteral} AS vector), update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS chunk_id, c.doc_id AS doc_id, c.kb_id AS kb_id, c.text AS text, c.ordinal AS ordinal, c.chunk_type AS chunk_type, c.parent_chunk_id AS parent_chunk_id, c.page_start AS page_start, c.page_end AS page_end, c.block_ids_json AS block_ids_json, c.context_prefix AS context_prefix, COALESCE(d.title, '') AS title, (c.embedding_vec <=> CAST(#{vectorLiteral} AS vector)) AS distance FROM kb_chunk c LEFT JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = c.doc_id AND d.deleted = FALSE WHERE c.kb_id = #{kbId} AND c.deleted = FALSE AND c.embedding_vec IS NOT NULL AND c.doc_version = d.active_version ORDER BY c.embedding_vec <=> CAST(#{vectorLiteral} AS vector) LIMIT #{k}
